stampedlock-optimistic-read-concept-034.title: Use optimistic reads with StampedLock
stampedlock-optimistic-read-concept-034.summary: StampedLock supports optimistic reads validated after reading.
stampedlock-optimistic-read-concept-034.why: Read-heavy shared state can sometimes avoid acquiring a read lock every time.
stampedlock-optimistic-read-concept-034.tips: If validation fails, acquire a read lock and read again.

classvalue-associated-data-concept-034.title: Associate data with classes using ClassValue
classvalue-associated-data-concept-034.summary: ClassValue associates lazily computed values with Class objects.
classvalue-associated-data-concept-034.why: It provides a class-aware way to manage auxiliary metadata.

collections-ncopies-immutable-view-034.title: Create a list containing repeated elements
collections-ncopies-immutable-view-034.summary: Collections.nCopies returns an unmodifiable list containing one element reference repeatedly.
collections-ncopies-immutable-view-034.why: It expresses repeated fixed values without a manual loop.
collections-ncopies-immutable-view-034.tips: A mutable element is shared by every position.

cancelledkeyexception-selectionkey-034.title: Operate on a cancelled SelectionKey
cancelledkeyexception-selectionkey-034.summary: CancelledKeyException is thrown when an operation requiring a valid SelectionKey follows cancellation.
cancelledkeyexception-selectionkey-034.why: A cancelled key no longer represents a usable selector registration.

overlappingfilelockexception-lock-034.title: Acquire overlapping file locks in one JVM
overlappingfilelockexception-lock-034.summary: OverlappingFileLockException occurs when a requested file-lock region overlaps one already held in the JVM.
overlappingfilelockexception-lock-034.why: Overlapping requests cannot be independent locks in the same JVM.
overlappingfilelockexception-lock-034.tips: Manage FileLock with try-with-resources and avoid overlapping ranges.

generic-erasure-name-clash-error-034.title: Declare methods that clash after type erasure
generic-erasure-name-clash-error-034.short: Do not overload only by generic arguments
generic-erasure-name-clash-error-034.summary: Methods differing only as List<String> versus List<Integer> erase to the same signature.
generic-erasure-name-clash-error-034.why: Generic arguments cannot distinguish those methods after erasure.
generic-erasure-name-clash-error-034.tips: Use distinct names or a common generic abstraction.

enum-switch-duplicate-default-error-034.title: Declare multiple default labels in one switch
enum-switch-duplicate-default-error-034.summary: A switch cannot contain more than one default label.
enum-switch-duplicate-default-error-034.why: There must be one destination for otherwise unmatched values.
enum-switch-duplicate-default-error-034.tips: Consolidate fallback handling into one default branch.

fallthrough-switch-lint-warning-034.title: Detect unintended switch fall-through
fallthrough-switch-lint-warning-034.summary: The fallthrough lint warning identifies case bodies that may continue into the next case.
fallthrough-switch-lint-warning-034.why: A missing break can compile while producing an unexpected result.
fallthrough-switch-lint-warning-034.tips: Add break when fall-through is unintended.

arrays-equals-nested-array-trap-034.title: Compare nested arrays with Arrays.equals
arrays-equals-nested-array-trap-034.summary: Arrays.equals does not recursively compare nested array contents.
arrays-equals-nested-array-trap-034.why: An array's own equals method is not element-by-element content equality.

bigdecimal-constructor-double-trap-034.title: Construct BigDecimal directly from double
bigdecimal-constructor-double-trap-034.short: Prefer valueOf or a decimal string
bigdecimal-constructor-double-trap-034.summary: new BigDecimal(double) captures the exact binary floating-point approximation.
bigdecimal-constructor-double-trap-034.why: Most decimal fractions cannot be represented exactly in binary floating point.
bigdecimal-constructor-double-trap-034.tips: Use BigDecimal.valueOf or a string constructor for intended decimal values.
